description: Recently signed U.S. federal new awards from USAspending.gov, newest first. Returns the newest 25 by default (set `limit`; page with `offset`); `total_matched` reports the full count. Optional min_amount (USD floor) and `days` (last-N-days window). Every award carries its source award_url; awards without a source link are dropped and never returned.

days.description: Only awards signed within the last N days.

limit.description: Max rows to return (default 25, newest first). Page with offset; the response's total_matched shows the full count. limit<=0 = no cap.

min_amount.description: Only awards at or above this USD amount

offset.description: Rows to skip before this page (pagination). Default 0.

name: federal_awards_recent
title: Recent federal contract awards (USAspending)
